features.title: [Feature][backend]Manual run lifecycle
features.statement: The user can submit an eligible manual run using the explicitly selected dataset, skill, and customer model and see the actual terminal outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Given an eligible dataset, an explicitly chosen supported skill, and a selected customer model, when the user starts a manual run, then the saved run identifies those selections and its real outcome; invalid results remain failures. Oracles: TC60, TC61, TC62.
outputs: Saved manual run with selected scope and explicit succeeded/failed outcome.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Validated output boundary
features.statement: Only a valid response matching the approved result contract and requested snapshot/skill may be presented as a finding; invalid responses remain explicit failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a response that matches the approved output contract and the requested snapshot/skill, when validation completes, then it can be shown as a finding; malformed or mismatched responses are failed outcomes with no finding. Oracles: TC61, TC66.
outputs: Validated finding for a matching response or an explicit non-success for a negative fixture.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Immutable result lineage
features.statement: The owner can revisit each saved assessment with its input, preprocessing, skill/model, run-time, and evidence references while earlier runs remain intact.
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved result and a later run over the same scope, when the owner revisits history after reload, then both run records remain separate and each shows its own required lineage. Oracles: TC64, TC65, TC67.
outputs: Separate retrievable assessments with their own lineage after reload and rerun.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Snapshot-bound evidence links
features.statement: An owner can resolve finding evidence to the assessment input snapshot; broken, foreign, or mismatched references are visibly unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved finding with a valid, broken, or unauthorized evidence reference, when the owner opens it, then only evidence for that result snapshot resolves and other references are identified as unavailable. Oracle: TC66.
outputs: Same-snapshot evidence references or an explicit unavailable state.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][frontend]Saved results dashboard
features.statement: The owner can view approved saved readiness, results, evidence, and failures without invoking a model.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved results and model access disabled, when the owner views the approved dashboard, then saved values and failures remain viewable without an inference request and agree with the approved output contract. Oracles: TC68-TC70.
outputs: Dashboard values and failures derived from saved outputs with zero inference calls for viewing.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Read-only output API
features.statement: An authenticated owner can retrieve saved outputs through the approved read-only API, with values consistent with the dashboard and foreign data withheld.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated owner and a saved result, when the owner retrieves it through the approved read-only API, then returned values match the saved dashboard representation; a foreign request reveals no other-user data and a mutation changes nothing. Oracles: TC70-TC74.
outputs: Authorized saved-output responses consistent with dashboard values; mutation attempts leave state unchanged.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][security]Cross-user isolation
features.statement: User files, credentials, manual runs, and saved results remain separated across supported access paths.
acceptance_criteria: Given two disposable users, when either user requests the other user file, credential operation, run, or result, then the request is denied before foreign data is used or returned. Oracles: TC73, TC74.
outputs: Owner operations work and cross-user reads or execution are denied before foreign data is used.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][frontend]Identity-bound interface state
features.statement: Changing the active account cannot display a delayed or cached result belonging to the prior account.
acceptance_criteria: Given user A has a delayed identity-scoped response, when the active identity changes to user B before it arrives, then the response is discarded or reauthorized and no user A data renders in user B view. Oracle: TC75.
outputs: Identity-scoped view state refreshed or discarded at account change; stale values never render.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][security]Safe credential and failure outputs
features.statement: Saved user-visible run outcomes omit credential material and unredacted provider payloads while preserving explicit failure status.
acceptance_criteria: Given success and failure run outputs containing controlled secret/provider-payload sentinels, when result, dashboard, and API views are retrieved, then no credential or unredacted provider payload is exposed and failure remains explicit. Oracles: TC63, TC76.
outputs: Safe saved success/failure representations with no credential or raw provider-payload sentinels.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

features.title: [Feature][frontend]Accessible run and result interactions
features.statement: The approved P0 run, history, denial, and retrieval interactions remain keyboard operable and communicate errors/status semantically.
acceptance_criteria: Given the owner-approved accessibility target and the run, result, denial, and retrieval states, when those flows are exercised, then controls are keyboard operable with perceivable focus, errors identify controls, and state is conveyed semantically as well as by color. Oracle: TC78.
outputs: Keyboard operability, perceivable focus, associated errors, and non-color async status in approved flows.
features.notes: Proposal only; not approved or verified.

system_requirements.title: [SR][backend]Reject invalid model output before assessment persistence
system_requirements.statement: The system shall accept a model response as an assessment only when it validates against the approved output contract and matches the run's selected snapshot and skill version; otherwise it shall record a non-success outcome and shall not expose it as a finding.
acceptance_criteria: Given a response matching the approved output contract, snapshot, and skill version, when validation completes, then a finding may be presented. Given a malformed response or mismatch, then the run is non-success and no finding is exposed. Oracle: TC61 and TC66; contract specifics remain gated by D02/D03.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Discard stale identity-bound responses
system_requirements.statement: The dashboard shall not render an identity-scoped response initiated for a prior authenticated user after the active identity changes; it shall discard or reauthorize the response before rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request for user A is delayed, when the active identity changes to user B before the response arrives, then user A values do not render for user B; the response is discarded or authorized for user B before use. Oracle: TC75; identity behavior remains unresolved under D04.

system_requirements.title: [SR][backend]Bind finding evidence to its saved input snapshot
system_requirements.statement: Every resolvable evidence reference returned for a saved finding shall identify evidence bound to that result's input snapshot; broken or unauthorized references shall be unavailable and never replaced with unrelated evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved finding with valid evidence for its snapshot, when its owner opens the evidence, then the evidence resolves to that snapshot. Given broken, cross-snapshot, or unauthorized evidence, then it is marked unavailable and no substitute is shown. Oracle: TC66/TC67; representation remains subject to D04.

system_requirements.title: [SR][backend]Prevent cross-user resource disclosure in retrieval
system_requirements.statement: Every collection and direct read of user-scoped output resources shall authorize against the current user before returning values; foreign identifiers or cursors shall not reveal another user's data or resource existence.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated owner, when the owner retrieves a saved output, then the authorized value is returned. Given another user valid identifier or cursor, when it is queried, then no foreign value or resource-existence signal is returned. Oracle: TC73/TC74; exact error behavior remains open under D04.

system_requirements.title: [SR][security]Exclude credentials and unsafe provider payloads from outputs
system_requirements.statement: The system shall omit credential material and unredacted provider request or response payloads from saved run outcomes and their dashboard/API representations, including failures, while preserving an explicit safe failure status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a run result or failure containing unique credential/provider-payload sentinels, when the owner views the saved run, dashboard, or API representation, then no sentinel or raw provider payload is present and the actual failure status remains visible. Oracle: TC63/TC76. Log handling remains governed by existing SR13 and is not broadened here.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Operate run and result interactions by keyboard
system_requirements.statement: Every interactive control in approved P0 run, saved-result, and retrieval flows shall be keyboard operable with perceivable focus; validation errors shall be associated with affected controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner using the approved run/result/retrieval flows, when each action is performed using keyboard only, then every control can be reached and operated and focus remains perceivable after state changes; each validation error identifies its control. Oracle: TC78; D04/D05 must set the test target.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Expose run states without color alone
system_requirements.statement: The dashboard shall communicate success, failure, evidence availability, and access denial using text/semantic state as well as color, and expose asynchronous changes through the declared accessible status mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Given pending, succeeded, failed, evidence-unavailable, and access-denied states, when shown in an approved P0 view, then each state is identified by text/semantic output as well as color and asynchronous changes are announced through the approved accessibility mechanism. Oracles: TC69/TC78; target remains open under D04/D05.

acceptance_criteria: Given foreign identifiers/cursors and the D04 error decision, when denial behavior is reviewed, then the questions needed to prevent data/existence disclosure are listed without choosing codes; oracle TC73.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Implement file/run checks
subtasks.statement: Implement file/run checks. Given a user requesting their own file/run, when authorization is checked, then their permitted operation completes; oracle TC74.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requesting their own file/run, when authorization is checked, then their permitted operation completes; oracle TC74.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Implement history/API checks
subtasks.statement: Implement history/API checks. Given a user requesting another users file/run/result, when authorization is checked before use, then the operation is denied and no foreign value is returned; oracle TC73/TC74.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requesting another users file/run/result, when authorization is checked before use, then the operation is denied and no foreign value is returned; oracle TC73/TC74.

subtasks.title: [Task][frontend]Keep prior-identity data out of the current view
subtasks.statement: Given identity A changes to identity B while an A request is pending, when the A response arrives, then A data is not visible in B current view; oracle TC75.
acceptance_criteria: Given identity A changes to identity B while an A request is pending, when the response arrives, then no A data is visible in B current view; oracle TC75.

subtasks.title: [Task][frontend]Discard or reauthorize stale responses
subtasks.statement: Discard or reauthorize stale responses. Given a delayed response from the prior identity, when it arrives after the change, then it is discarded or authorized for the current identity before rendering; oracle TC75.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delayed response from the prior identity, when it arrives after the change, then it is discarded or authorized for the current identity before rendering; oracle TC75.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Prepare two-user requests
subtasks.statement: Prepare two-user requests. Given two disposable accounts, when owner and foreign IDs/cursors are prepared, then each protected boundary has one reproducible positive and negative request; oracle TC73/TC74.
acceptance_criteria: Given two disposable accounts, when owner and foreign IDs/cursors are prepared, then each protected boundary has one reproducible positive and negative request; oracle TC73/TC74.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Execute denials/stale-response/retrieval cases
subtasks.statement: Execute denials/stale-response/retrieval cases. Given the fixed candidate and two accounts, when each protected path and delayed identity response is exercised, then no cross-user data appears and actual denials are recorded; oracle TC14/TC73-TC75.
acceptance_criteria: Given the fixed candidate and two accounts, when each protected path and delayed identity response is exercised, then no cross-user data appears and actual denials are recorded; oracle TC14/TC73-TC75.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Implement safe failure mapping
subtasks.statement: Implement safe failure mapping. Given a saved success/failure containing controlled sensitive sentinels, when supported user-facing output is produced, then safe status remains while secret/provider raw payloads are absent; oracle TC63/TC76.
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved success/failure containing controlled sensitive sentinels, when supported user-facing output is produced, then safe status remains while secret/provider raw payloads are absent; oracle TC63/TC76.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Redact sensitive output fields
subtasks.statement: Redact sensitive output fields. Given a response includes secret or raw provider-error fields, when saved result/dashboard/API representations are read, then those fields are not exposed; logs remain outside this requirement under SR13; oracle TC63/TC76.
acceptance_criteria: Given a response includes secret or raw provider-error fields, when saved result/dashboard/API representations are read, then those fields are not exposed; logs remain outside this requirement under SR13; oracle TC63/TC76.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Prepare unique sentinels
subtasks.statement: Prepare unique sentinels. Given the approved test contract, when sentinel values are prepared for result and failure outputs, then each value is unique and the expected absence is recorded; oracle TC63/TC76.
acceptance_criteria: Given the approved test contract, when sentinel values are prepared for result and failure outputs, then each value is unique and the expected absence is recorded; oracle TC63/TC76.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Inspect supported surfaces
subtasks.statement: Inspect supported surfaces. Given those sentinels, when saved results/status/dashboard/API output is inspected, then actual presence/absence is recorded and no log-handling claim is made; oracle TC63/TC76.
acceptance_criteria: Given those sentinels, when saved results/status/dashboard/API output is inspected, then actual presence/absence is recorded and no log-handling claim is made; oracle TC63/TC76.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]List unknowns
subtasks.statement: List unknowns. Given the project sources, when history lifecycle questions are enumerated, then retention, backup/restore, access and legal applicability unknowns are separated from established facts; oracle TC77.
acceptance_criteria: Given the project sources, when history lifecycle questions are enumerated, then retention, backup/restore, access and legal applicability unknowns are separated from established facts; oracle TC77.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Record source or decision owner
subtasks.statement: Record source or decision owner. Given each unresolved item, when the decision brief is completed, then a source with its limits or an accountable owner decision is recorded, and no period/legal outcome is inferred; oracle TC77.
acceptance_criteria: Given each unresolved item, when the decision brief is completed, then a source with its limits or an accountable owner decision is recorded, and no period/legal outcome is inferred; oracle TC77.

subtasks.title: [Task][accessibility]Assess accessibility applicability for P0 interactions
subtasks.statement: [Task][accessibility]Assess accessibility applicability for P0 interactions
acceptance_criteria: Given proposed P0 interactions, when accessibility applicability is reviewed, then keyboard/focus/error/status concerns and known evidence gaps are recorded without choosing conformance targets; oracle TC78.

subtasks.title: [Task][accessibility]Record unselected accessibility targets and owners
subtasks.statement: [Task][accessibility]Record unselected accessibility targets and owners
acceptance_criteria: Given each needed test target, when the assessment is reviewed, then unresolved formal standard/browser/viewport/AT choices are explicitly assigned for decision; oracle TC78.

verification_cases.title: Manual run lifecycle states
verification_cases.procedure: On the approved fixed candidate, submit one controlled run for each configured valid, malformed, authentication-failure, timeout, and provider-error fixture. Record run ID, persisted status, visible status, and whether a finding exists. Compare each with the D03-approved outcome; a fake adapter validates only lifecycle handling, not live-model quality.
verification_cases.expected: Pending/success/auth-error/timeout/provider-error match approved states; only validated success is terminal success.

verification_cases.title: Invalid output rejection
verification_cases.procedure: Submit one contract-conforming response, then responses with malformed structure, unsupported classification, wrong snapshot/skill version, and missing evidence. For each record validation result, run status, and whether any finding is exposed; use the approved D02/D03 contract as oracle.
verification_cases.expected: Valid output alone becomes assessment; malformed schema/classification/snapshot/version/evidence becomes non-success with no finding.

verification_cases.title: Run selection binding
verification_cases.procedure: As one disposable user, choose a known scope/snapshot/skill/connection/model and submit a run. Compare the saved request and dispatched connection with the selection; repeat with unavailable selected access and confirm no alternate connection is called.
verification_cases.expected: Persisted request and dispatch equal explicit scope/snapshot/skill/connection/model; no alternative connection called.

verification_cases.title: Sanitized failure record
verification_cases.procedure: Use unique sentinel credentials and provider-error payloads in controlled success/failure responses. Retrieve saved run status and result through supported views; record presence/absence and confirm the failure remains explicit.
verification_cases.expected: Unique secret/provider sentinels in failures do not appear in retrieved failure output.

verification_cases.title: Result lineage resolution
verification_cases.procedure: Create one saved assessment from a known fixture. Retrieve its lineage fields and resolve each to the selected input, preprocessing version, skill/model, run time, and evidence supplied for that run; report any missing/mismatched reference.
verification_cases.expected: Snapshot/preprocessing/skill/model/time/evidence fields resolve to actual source and run.

verification_cases.title: Append-only rerun history
verification_cases.procedure: Run the same selected snapshot twice with distinct controlled outcomes. Retrieve both records and compare IDs and the earlier record before/after rerun; the first record must remain unchanged and separately addressable.
verification_cases.expected: Two same-scope runs have distinct IDs and first record/lineage remain unchanged.

verification_cases.title: Evidence reference binding
verification_cases.procedure: Create valid same-snapshot, broken, cross-snapshot, and foreign-user evidence references. As the result owner, open each finding and record which reference resolves; only valid same-snapshot authorized evidence may resolve.
verification_cases.expected: Only valid same-snapshot authorized evidence resolves; broken/cross-snapshot/foreign refs are unavailable.

verification_cases.title: History across restart
verification_cases.procedure: Persist at least one successful and one failed result with lineage using disposable data. Restart the service using the recorded candidate/setup, retrieve both records, then rerun one scope and confirm prior records remain distinct.
verification_cases.expected: After restart prior result/lineage remains retrievable and rerun creates distinct record.

verification_cases.title: Dashboard without inference
verification_cases.procedure: Disable inference/model access before loading each D04-approved saved dashboard view. Capture displayed record IDs and inference-request count; verify values load from saved records and request count remains zero.
verification_cases.expected: With inference disabled, approved saved views render and inference requests equal zero.

verification_cases.title: Dashboard states and provenance
verification_cases.procedure: Using controlled saved records, render the D04-approved empty, populated, warning, failed, evidence-unavailable, and denied states. Capture visible text/semantic state and verify each distinction does not depend on color alone.
verification_cases.expected: Approved status states match saved contract and never rely on color alone.

verification_cases.title: Dashboard/API parity
verification_cases.procedure: For a fixed authorized saved fixture, capture dashboard values and corresponding API values/identifiers, canonicalize only as the approved contract allows, and compare each field. Attempt approved read-only mutation probes and confirm persisted state is unchanged.
verification_cases.expected: Canonicalized dashboard saved values/IDs equal API; read-only attempts do not mutate.

verification_cases.title: Read-only output retrieval and mutation behavior
verification_cases.procedure: Using the founder-approved read-only operations and output contract, retrieve owned saved output and attempt operations not allowed by that contract. Compare returned values with the saved result and compare persisted state before and after; operation, representation and error details are defined by D04.
verification_cases.expected: Authorized read-only retrieval returns only the intended saved values; disallowed mutation attempts leave persisted state unchanged and produce the D04-approved outcome. This case does not select the operation or representation.

verification_cases.title: API pagination/query errors
verification_cases.procedure: With a fixed saved collection and approved pagination/query rules, fetch successive pages and repeat a cursor, then submit each approved invalid-query fixture. Check for omissions/duplicates and compare error responses with the approved contract; unresolved bounds remain blocked.
verification_cases.expected: Repeated cursors preserve ordering; invalid queries use stable errors.

verification_cases.title: Cross-user retrieval isolation
verification_cases.procedure: Use two disposable accounts. Request direct and collection output owned by the other account using valid foreign IDs and cursors; record status/body and confirm neither foreign values nor a resource-existence signal is disclosed under approved D04 behavior.
verification_cases.expected: Foreign direct/collection IDs/cursors reveal no other-user data or existence.

verification_cases.title: Authorization boundaries
verification_cases.procedure: Using two test identities, probe file access, credential operation, run submission/status, history, dashboard and result retrieval as owner and non-owner. Verify denial occurs before foreign data use/execution and record every boundary result.
verification_cases.expected: Owner access succeeds; foreign file/credential/run/result actions denied before protected use.

verification_cases.title: Identity switch delayed response
verification_cases.procedure: Start a history/result request as user A and hold its response. Change the active identity to user B, release the response, and inspect rendered state/network result; user A values must not render for B.
verification_cases.expected: Prior-user values never render after identity changes during an outstanding request.

verification_cases.title: Credential/provider payload inspection
verification_cases.procedure: Place unique sentinels in controlled success/failure payload fields. Inspect only saved run status/result, dashboard representation, and output API response. Record hits; do not inspect logs or claim SR13 verification.
verification_cases.expected: Unique sentinels are absent from saved run status/results, dashboard representations, and output API responses. This case does not inspect logs; existing SR13 governs log credential handling.

verification_cases.title: Operations/legal investigation
verification_cases.procedure: Inspect the current brief, WP01 proposal, decision register, and authoritative evidence available to the reviewer for retention, backup, restoration, access and legal applicability. Report source limits and named unresolved decisions; do not infer law, time periods, or recovery targets.
verification_cases.expected: Evidence/decision owners recorded for retention/backup/restore and applicable law; no values/conclusions invented.

verification_cases.title: Rendered accessibility acceptance
verification_cases.procedure: After D04/D05 define the supported browser, viewport, assistive-technology setup and applicable target, complete the approved run/result/retrieval states with keyboard and semantic output. Record versions, fixture IDs, steps, focus/errors/status announcements and limitations; if setup/decision is absent, leave blocked.
verification_cases.expected: Approved browser/viewport/AT keyboard/semantic flows show focus, associated errors, non-color states and async announcements.

verification_cases.title: Integrated owned-scope procedure
verification_cases.procedure: Independently inspect this fragment against the frozen schema and coverage rubric: IDs/ranges, reciprocal CUS-feature-SR links, WP/parent/task/leaf/TC links, dependencies, ownership, implementation plus verification coverage, decision readiness, and evidence status. Report exact rows/gaps. This is a traceability audit; TC15 athlete validation remains separate.
verification_cases.expected: CUS07–10 mapped to reproducible checks; missing evidence remains Not run/blocked.

notes: D01-D05 remain open; all derived SRs and capabilities are proposals. No founder decision or verification is implied.
Existing SR statements/statuses and TC01-TC20 remain unchanged. TC15 remains the planned final athlete validation; TC79 is a separate traceability audit and does not replace TC15.
Future implementation/test tasks are plans only. No code, detailed architecture, endpoint design, retention value, legal conclusion, or test evidence is added.
SR74/TC76 cover user-visible saved run outputs; credential handling in logs remains under existing SR13. CUS11-CUS13 remain out of scope.
